title: feat(nm2simz): simultaneous M and O at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, z-probes, simultaneous (signed-letter disjointness of M and O). Establishes sim as strictly weaker than cover: it notes that on the same seed y-probe D has letter-disjoint nonempty M and O yet FAILs complementary axis cover.
